summary: Sandboxed the install child (lane-owned HOME/XDG/npm dirs, stripped home- and repo-naming env, lane cwd) and added a before/after boundary snapshot of the checkout top level and .git/hooks that refuses install.script-wrote-outside-lane naming every path; semantics are detect-and-refuse, not prevent, and that is recorded in notEstablished. Added <root>/.git/hooks to the counter's C1 snapshot set. Deleted all 19 husky-referencing non-sample files from .git/hooks (all verified to reference husky first); 14 .sample files left. Tests: env unit test, real-npm escape test, counter hook test. Regenerated census and trust after vp pack. Suite 2711/2 skipped; proven 11; freeze 27741d9c stable.
open_questions: npm 12 blocks dependency install scripts behind allowScripts; --foreground-scripts does not grant it, so --allow-install-scripts does not currently run a dependency's native build. Fixing it means emitting --dangerously-allow-all-scripts, which moves the plan, census and lane-install-build.json — deliberately not done here.
